title: Lorepack v2 record (one JSONL line)
description: One line of a .lorepack(.gz) file. v2 as exported by MYTHOS-LOREPACK-FACTORY-MVP src/packer.ts, plus the additive v2.1 fields marked [v2.1]. Additive fields are safe: the factory reader ignores unknown keys on header, vector and edge records. A NEW record type is not safe: the factory reader treats any type other than header/manifest/edge as a vector and throws. Author: SYS.AI.MAYA.SESAME.

visibility.description: [v2.1] Who may read this record through another agent's query. Absent: the owner's exposure.default_visibility (default self).

header.description: First line. The factory reader skips it; the player requires it.

agent.description: [v2.1] The agent's system name, e.g. SYS.AI.MAYA. agentId stays the roster id.

agentNumber.description: [v2.1] Merk's agent number, zero-padded roster order, e.g. 015 for Maya.

bodySha256.description: [v2.1] sha256 of the UTF-8 bytes of every line after the header, each ending in \n, as stored (uncompressed).

recordSetSha256.description: [v2.1] The pack version: sha256 of the sorted record ids joined by \n. Independent of order, compression and whitespace.

idScheme.description: [v2.1] How vector ids were made. node-v1: sha256(AGENT:trim(lower(text))). node-v2: sha256(AGENT:source:NFC-collapsed-lower(text)).

seq.description: [v2.1] Version sequence in the store for this pack tag.

parents.description: [v2.1] recordSetSha256 of the version(s) this one was made from. Two parents = a sync merge.

segment.description: [v2.1] append: holds only new chunks and their edges on top of parents[0].

extractionModel.description: [v2.1] Model used for triplets in this version (edges still carry og each).

vector.description: One chunk with its embedding. Its id is the chunk id that edges point at with src.

src.description: Source name. Must be stable for the same input (file name or content hash), never wall-clock time.

ps.description: [v2.1, in Maya's local patch] Triplet extraction status. completed with zero edges is a valid answer.

locus.description: Lore locus, e.g. MYTHOS.LORE.MAYA (not the SYS.AI locus).

edge.description: One triplet extracted from the chunk named by src.

src.description: Id of the vector (chunk) this triplet came from.

og.description: [v2.1, in Maya's local patch] Origin: the extraction model id, or the literal 'heuristic'. Required under the strict profile.

run.description: [v2.1] Extraction run id (ISO time or ulid). Per chunk, the newest run's edge set wins on rebuild and on sync.
